versions.changelog: Coordinated MPAS skill update. The proposer documents client-triggered progress, optional polling while awaiting approvals, and follow-up checks through completion. The maintainer confirms decision submission acceptance and distinguishes a Signer's decision from the Action's outcome. Both skills explicitly disclose their intended behavioral changes, scope persistent instruction installation to operator-requested role setup, and require separate proposer and maintainer agents.
Support both MCP Tasks and the compatibility wait tool (mpas_wait_for_action_result). Track Actions instead of assuming Tasks-only.
